run_extract_vocabulary: run the extract_vocabulary module to build a word vocabulary from SIMMC train dialogue JSON
create_vocabulary_with_threshold: create a vocabulary from dialogue transcripts filtered by minimum word occurrence threshold
build_vocabulary_from_dialogue: build a vocabulary by tokenizing transcript and system_transcript fields from SIMMC dialogue data
test_extract_vocabulary: test the extract_vocabulary module with a train JSON path and vocab save path
review_main_function: review the main function that counts word frequencies and writes a JSON vocabulary file
